description:

description:

description:

title: Dino Hunters
description:

Clayton and Luke begin to excavate the deep overburden that covers the Tyrannosaurus rex site; while Mike Harris travels to Utah to prep the Cowboy Rex skull, Aaron, Jake and Tori think they're on a bucket-list discovery at the Duckbill site.

title: Dino Hunters
description:

title: Dino Hunters
description:

title: Dino Hunters
description:

An undercover investigation targets a high-tech North Korean plot to counterfeit American $100 bills; an identity thief uses a clever hacking scheme to steal $100 million; when an ex-KGB agent dies, authorities come across a shocking find.

description:

Tragedy strikes the heart of a city as an earthquake wipes out a building full of people in Christchurch, New Zealand; experts investigate an inadequate structural design and weakness in critical supporting columns.

description:

The construction of a new parking garage at a luxury waterside condo turns disastrous as it collapses in Jacksonville, Fla.; experts use the latest tech to investigate and uncover critical design flaws and unsupported lower levels.

description:
